description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, which implements the LogNode interface. It acts as a filter in a logging chain, passing only message content and suppressing additional metadata. It is used for simplified, on-screen log output in Android applications.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A LogNode implementation that filters log messages to pass only the message content, useful for simplified on-screen logging.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Filters the log message to only pass the message to the next node, ignoring metadata.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
